Why knowing exactly what you want makes everything easier.

Kevin Trudeau says he does hundreds of one-on-one calls, and only a handful of people can state what they want the same way every time. He says it should be as instant as your name, your phone number or your address.

He says that without that clarity, reaching big goals doesn't become impossible. It just becomes harder and slower.

Could you say what you want in one instant sentence?
